description:
The perfect pairing. A SRAM Rival 13-speed wide-range groupset and a race-ready carbon fibre CF4 frame make the 6000 the perfect bike for aspiring gravel racers who don't want to sacrifice performance but still need to keep an eye on their budget.

The 13-speed SRAM groupset and proven DT Swiss G1800 wheelset are perfectly combined with our lightweight CF4 carbon MISSION frame to create the ideal gravel racing combination at a more budget-friendly price point. With a geometry between the road-biased SCULTURA ENDURANCE and the off-road-focused SILEX, the MISSION offers sharp, responsive handling on and off the road without compromising the control and confidence you need on more rugged gravel sections. The MISSION 6000 is the perfect tool for gravel gran fondos or fast, rough roads.

Our new MISSION truly embodies its ‘fast on any surface’ intentions. It is a gravel race bike that combines key geometry and frame elements from the SCULTURA ENDURANCE and the SILEX, sprinkles them with a heavy dose of road racing DNA to deliver a fast and responsive ride on pretty much any surface.

Whether you're tackling fast-paced gravel races to tarmac-based chain gang outings, the MISSION delivers. With up to 40 mm tyre clearance, there is scope for wider gravel racing tyres or large volume road tyres, and its low weight of around 7.8 kg of the 10K model makes it fly up the hills, keeps it super responsive and catapults it out of corners. The MISSION’s built-in storage compartment improves the accessibility and organisation of crucial mid-race nutrition and spares, further enhancing the efficiency when every second counts.

Finally, the ability to seamlessly fit 1x or 2x drivetrains gives riders more flexibility to find their preferred setup for whatever riding or racing style they want to focus on. Welcome to your MISSION - Fast on any surface.

"Fast, versatile, fun and the perfect all-road and gravel race bike", so the summarised statements of a long list of international cycling titles like Bikerumor, Gran Fondo, Bikeboard, Road.cc and RadFahren (just to name a few) when they put our MISSION through its paces.
